scope: Source-bound native Python Mapping v3 verification in the reconciled project verifier
meaning: Reuse every shared source Mapping case and recipe, using the existing Python MAPPING_INPUT error boundary without changing the source oracle or generator.

Bind registered checked public Mappings and native module metadata to source graph, field compilation, declared endpoint uses, ontology paths and exact Interface imports; retain no duplicate child artifacts.

Observe the complete generated provider and facade grammar, structural types, Interface binding guards and direct Interface dependencies before runtime replay, including dependencies whose own case budgets are pending.
Execute all ready cases and compare the ordered projected fields, exact values, repeated fresh immutable results, detached mutable inputs and absence of mutation, coercion or observed effects.

Preserve explicit supplied calculations, null-only fallback, optional absence, ordered lists, canonical unique sets, explicit to_set and field-projection deduplication. Do not execute a calculation implicitly.
A public or domain-target Mapping returns only its declared projection. It never constructs an Entity, executes factory invariants, calls Interface members or performs transport.

Require three immutable binding controls and two compiling source substitutions per ready Mapping. Preserve the enclosing verifier's exact workspace custody, prerequisite invalidation, toolchain identity and cleanup.

capacity.overflow: whole row not_evaluable; no passing prefix
capacity.transport: existing bounded stdin and isolated Python process; no second workspace

claim_ceiling: Finite source cases and recognition of the selected generated grammar, not arbitrary Python equivalence, a hostile-code sandbox, full CLI qualification, profile activation, approval or release.
